result.summary: Independently read test/specs/REQ-029.md and test/letflow/definitions/graph_test.exs directly (not TEST-DESIGNER's summary). Verified each of REQ-029's 5 acceptance criteria against docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-029 entry text (exact wording match confirmed) and against actual test code: AC1 (7 node types) -- HUMAN_TASK missing role (line 426), SERVICE_TASK missing endpoint (460), SERVICE_TASK invalid timeout 0 and 300001 (492, 507) plus boundary-valid 1/300000 (524), TIMER missing/invalid duration (566, 591) and P0D explicitly accepted (577), START/END/EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY/PARALLEL_GATEWAY accepting no attributes (628-640) -- all present as runnable tests. AC2 -- is_default:true with non-null condition rejected, asserting exact 2-code list [:unexpected_edge_condition, :default_with_condition] (line 712-727). AC3 -- two/three is_default edges on one gateway rejected with N-1 violations, plus a legal one-default happy-path test (734-784). AC4 -- valid_cel_syntax?/1 accepts 2 well-formed expressions, rejects 6 distinct malformed ones, and has an explicit standalone test asserting no-evaluation behavior on a nonsense variable reference (810-838), plus a wiring/integration test proving it's actually called from validate_edge_conditions/1 (792-804). AC5 -- extra undeclared keys (including a nested-map value) on HUMAN_TASK and SERVICE_TASK nodes produce no violation (678-705). Ran grep across both files for @tag :skip / @tag :pending, TODO, and hardcoded secrets/connection-string patterns (password|secret|api_key|postgres://|mysql://|AKIA|token=) -- zero matches on all three. Fixture review: every test constructs its own literal %Graph{}/%Node{}/%Edge{} inline via local helper calls (attr_node/3, cond_edge/5, node/2, edge/3, graph/2) with test-local ids ('h1', 'st1', 'gw', etc. scoped to that test only) -- no module-level mutable state, no test reads another test's data, no ordering dependency; module uses `async: true` with no Ecto.Sandbox/Repo touch, consistent with the pure-function contract. This is a WF-02 requirement test (not a WF-03 regression test), so the pre-fix-failure-confirmation check does not apply. Independently re-ran (not trusting TEST-DESIGNER's reported 40/0): `mix test test/letflow/definitions/graph_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 0.3 seconds (0.3s async, 0.00s sync) / 40 tests, 0 failures'. One unrelated stderr line logged during the run ('Metadata load failed for issuer https://placeholder-keycloak.invalid...') is a pre-existing OIDC-client background retry warning unrelated to this test file's pure-function scope, not a test failure -- exit reflected 0 failures. All 5 checks (a-e) from WF-02 Step 3b pass. Verdict: PASS.
